Rejects an unknown external finding offset encoding

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { ExtractInput, ExtractInputKind, extractWithExternalRedaction } from "@xberg-io/xberg";
async function main() {
  const input: ExtractInput = { bytes: Uint8Array.from([90, 97, 114, 110, 97, 107]), filename: "external-findings-invalid.txt", kind: ExtractInputKind.Bytes, mimeType: "text/plain" };
  try {
    await extractWithExternalRedaction(input, undefined, "[{\"category\":\"inspection_person\",\"text\":\"Zarnak\",\"confidenceScore\":0.99,\"warnings\":[]}]", "bytes-ish", 8);
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof Error) {
      console.error(`${error.name}: ${error.message}`);
    }
  }
}

void main();
```
